mcqs.question: In the QS World Future Skills Index 2027, what was India's rank in the Future of Work pillar?
mcqs.explanation: India ranked 5th in the Future of Work pillar of the QS World Future Skills Index 2027. The 14th, 18th and 22nd ranks relate to other pillars, not Future of Work.

mcqs.question: According to the Hurun Global Unicorn Index 2026, how many unicorns existed worldwide, and what was their combined value?
mcqs.explanation: The Hurun Global Unicorn Index 2026 reported 1,603 unicorns worldwide, valued at USD 8 trillion. The figures 806, 381 and 70 refer to country-wise unicorn counts, not the global total.
